shots.name: 11-bestiary
shots.doc: The whole spawn roster in one rank, small to large, with two tier-2 elites. Judges silhouette variety and scale spread.

shots.name: 12-boss-phases
shots.doc: A late-phase boss frozen at 85% of a wind-up. Judges boss silhouette at scale and telegraph legibility.

shots.name: 13-biomes-1
shots.doc: Establishing shot of biome 1 of 4, framed on its primary landmark. Judges whether the four stages read as genuinely different places rather than as one generator recoloured.

shots.doc: Establishing shot of biome 2 of 4, framed on its primary landmark. Judges whether the four stages read as genuinely different places rather than as one generator recoloured.

shots.name: 13-biomes-4
shots.doc: Establishing shot of biome 4 of 4, framed on its primary landmark. Judges whether the four stages read as genuinely different places rather than as one generator recoloured.

shots.name: 14-survivor-select
shots.doc: Survivor select: the four-strong roster, a rotating 3D portrait, the selected survivor's four abilities and roster-relative stat bars. Judges menu hierarchy, typography and whether the new content is legible before a run starts.

shots.name: 15-logbook
shots.doc: Logbook, survivors tab, with the 3D model viewer live. Judges the index/detail split, unlock and discovery states, and whether the browsing UI reads as the same product as the HUD.

shots.name: 16-run-summary
shots.doc: Run-end summary after a real death: survivor, difficulty, artifacts, time, stages, kills, damage, the run's item haul and anything earned. Judges whether the run reads back as a story rather than a number dump.
